name: The Engraved Ring
label: Quest
description: High Executor Hadrec sends an adventurer to Brill carrying a recovered wedding band inscribed to a woman named Deliah. Magistrate Sevren consults town…
intro: High Executor Hadrec sends an adventurer to Brill carrying a recovered wedding band inscribed to a woman named Deliah. Magistrate Sevren consults town records to investigate her identity and determine where the ring originated.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... Then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.
But I wouldn't hope. Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead. Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. What brings you back to Brill?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago. She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.
The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
